physicalNotes: Radius 1.47 Jupiter radii from Heidari et al. 2025 (2025A&A...694A..36H), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...694A..36H/abstract): 105,093.2 km at 71,492 km per Jupiter radius. GM from the mass 0.875 Jupiter masses (Heidari et al. 2025, the mass the NASA Exoplanet Archive's composite table adopts (2025A&A...694A..36H), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive, https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...694A..36H/abstract) times JPL's Jupiter GM.
